title: Dashes and text on a path
summary: Turn a line into marching dashes, taper a brush stroke, and send words traveling along a curve.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text:
Shape operators change how a drawn line looks each frame without redrawing it, and letter animators move a text field's letters while it stays editable.

The orange Track and the green Swash are plain lines. The Words layer sits under the Path motion guide, the thin gray curve, which is never drawn in the movie.

steps.title: Select the track
steps.text: Press V and click the orange line. It is a drawing object, so one click picks it whole.

steps.title: Open the Behaviors panel
steps.text: Choose Window > Behaviors if it is not showing. It lists what is on the selection and the settings of each.

steps.title: Add Dashes
steps.text: With a shape selected the button reads Add Operator. Click it and choose Dashes. The line is cut into dashes 20 pixels long with gaps of 10.

steps.title: Key the offset
steps.text: The playhead is on frame 1. Click the diamond beside Offset (pixels) to key it at 0 on this frame.

steps.title: Go to frame 120
steps.text: Click frame 120 on the Track layer, the last one.

steps.title: Offset at 600
steps.text: Set Offset (pixels) to 600. Since the setting is keyed, this makes a second key here.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. The dashes march along the line, like ants or a route on a map.

steps.title: Select the swash
steps.text: Press Enter again to stop. Click the thick green line.

steps.title: Taper it
steps.text:
Click Add Operator and choose Taper. The line thins from its start to a point at its end, like a stroke of a brush.

Set Start width and End width to taper it the way you like.

steps.title: Select the words
steps.text: Press Shift+, (Control > Rewind) to go back to frame 1, then click the words at the top.

steps.title: Put them on the path
steps.text: With text selected the button reads Add Animator. Click it and choose Text on a Path. The letters jump onto the gray guide and turn with its curve.

steps.title: Key the margin
steps.text: Set First margin (pixels) to -700: the words slide back off the start of the line, out of sight. Then click the diamond beside it to key it on this frame.

steps.title: Margin at 1300
steps.text: Set First margin (pixels) to 1300, past the end of the line.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. The words ride in along the curve, over the marching dashes, and off the far end.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text:
You made marching dashes, a tapered brush stroke and text that travels along a path, and every one stays editable: reshape the guide and the words follow it.

Try Above the line to lift the words off the curve, or Wrap round past the end for words that go round and round a closed path.
